basis: 2.1.0-alpha.0-review candidate diagram; proposals are not author decisions
multiplicity_policy: unknown unless explicitly established; no source-table foreign key is a conceptual cardinality

cases.proposal: Introduce an anti-rigid operator/responsible-organization Role inheriting Organization identity; mediate the Role while preserving Organization as Kind.
cases.counterexample: An Organization exists before it operates this Facility and may cease operation without losing identity.
cases.decision_needed: Is the operation truth-maker dependent on a current operator, and is one or more operator required per operation interval? Define both association-end bounds and role grounding.

cases.proposal: Introduce an anti-rigid operated-facility Role inheriting Facility identity if mediation is optional for Facility.
cases.counterexample: A physical Facility may exist while temporarily not operated by an Organization.
cases.decision_needed: Can an operation instance concern several facilities or sequential facilities? Specify cardinality, temporal scope, and the mediated facility role.

cases.proposal: Model a contextual registered-facility Role where the registration actually concerns a Facility; retain Organization as a separate possible regulated bearer.
cases.counterexample: An unregistered Facility remains a Facility; a source record may register an Organization instead.
cases.decision_needed: Resolve source-specific Facility versus Organization scope, regulated role, jurisdiction and end bounds; distinguish registration relator from registration record.

cases.proposal: Use an anti-rigid classified-entity Role if the assignment is the contextual dependence; keep Product and Substance identities distinct.
cases.counterexample: A Product or Substance can exist without this particular ATC/source classification assignment.
cases.decision_needed: Decide whether both Product and Substance are admitted, whether each assignment classifies exactly one bearer, and how the Role or justified read-only rigid end is represented.

cases.proposal: Treat the ClassificationEntry link as a reference if W4's 'references' wording is intentional; do not erase the relator's two-distinct-participant obligation.
cases.counterexample: A ClassificationEntry remains in its scheme even when no Product is assigned to it.
cases.decision_needed: Choose mediation with a justified relationally dependent Entry Role versus reference; if reference, identify the second mediated individual or revise the Relator pattern.

cases.proposal: Use a contextual listed-presentation Role inheriting Presentation identity; keep source-defined listing status as a contextual value.
cases.counterexample: A Presentation can be unlisted or listed only in a different jurisdiction or interval.
cases.decision_needed: Determine whether a labeler is always a mediated second party or only sometimes related; specify jurisdiction/time and lower bounds without inventing a labeler.

cases.proposal: Use a supported-assertion Role or justify a read-only rigid end; support participation never means that the assertion is true.
cases.counterexample: An Assertion can exist without a supporting EvidenceSupport and can be later challenged or retracted.
cases.decision_needed: Define target Assertion/Mapping/Match scope, support direction, source-to-assertion counts, and whether the end is read-only or an anti-rigid role.

cases.proposal: Represent IdentifierScheme as a reference if W4's 'references' is intentional; IdentifierValue remains a literal, never a mediated individual.
cases.counterexample: An IdentifierScheme can be defined before any particular entity receives an identifier.
cases.decision_needed: Identify a second distinct mediated individual after changing Scheme to reference, or revise the assignment as a different ontological pattern; resolve polymorphic bearer, issuer, validity and end bounds.

cases.proposal: Use a contextual reference/affected-product Role inheriting Product identity; the distinct alternative-product Role already has Product identity.
cases.counterexample: A Product may be a reference in one shortage context and unrelated to any alternative assignment in another.
cases.decision_needed: Confirm direction, Product versus Presentation scope, distinct relata and each end's bounds; preserve the no-self-alternative guard.

cases.proposal: Use source-bounded dependent/provider Roles with an explicit identity-bearing specialization; do not infer an Organization from the untyped W5 property.
cases.counterexample: An Organization may be a dependent, provider, both in different contexts, or neither; the dependent may instead be a Product, Facility or Activity.
cases.decision_needed: Choose direction-specific role bearers and admissible types, time/context and bounds using actual source evidence; C1 is conditional and does not establish a complete network.

cases.proposal: Use a provider/source-facility Role only where a Facility is actually a relatum; keep Product and Organization as other possibilities.
cases.counterexample: A dependency may connect two Products or two Organizations without any Facility, while a Facility may exist without being a supply source.
cases.decision_needed: Confirm that the current diagram's Organization–Facility pairing is merely illustrative, not a required pair; decide roles, participant distinctness and bounds.

cases.proposal: Prefer a PartnerOrganization Role for each participating Organization; retain the candidate two-distinct-participants rule provisionally in the optional extension.
cases.counterexample: An Organization can exist without a partnership; one Organization appearing twice does not establish a two-party agreement.
cases.decision_needed: Approve or reject Partnership-as-Relator and the two-distinct-Organization lower bound with independent evidence beyond V1/W1 lineage; settle role and agreement identity.

cases.proposal: Examine whether SourceRecord fills an EvidenceItem Role or is only a source/provenance reference; remove redundant direct mediation if it repeats the evidence-item position.
cases.counterexample: A SourceRecord may exist in a registry but not support this particular Assertion; two edges to the same record must not count as two individuals.
cases.decision_needed: Choose typed EvidenceItem role bearers and whether record and evidence positions may coincide; specify distinct participants and support provenance.

cases.proposal: Use an anti-rigid contextually-classified-entity Role where needed; preserve independent Product/Substance identity and the list/version context.
cases.counterexample: A Product outside a specific essential/critical list is still a Product; a source may classify a Substance instead.
cases.decision_needed: Resolve Product/Substance range mismatch between W4 and candidate OWL, scope of Essential versus Critical assignments and end bounds.

cases.proposal: Treat ClassificationEntry as a list/version reference if it is an independently maintained entry; test whether an actual classification assignment still has two mediated relata.
cases.counterexample: An entry can remain in a list even when no local Product participates in this assignment.
cases.decision_needed: Decide whether Entry is a mediated Role, a reference, or a context object of a different assignment pattern; add no cardinality without its domain rationale.
